facts.text: The resort is set on a hillside in Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai, and is part of MGallery by Accor.
facts.excerpt: is a 5-star luxury mountain resort under MGallery by Accor, set on a hillside in Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai

facts.text: The resort is about a 30-minute drive from downtown Chiang Mai.
facts.excerpt: The resort is about a 30-minute drive from downtown Chiang Mai

facts.text: Accommodations are set on a scenic valley slope with views over rice and tea terraces and multiple water features.
facts.excerpt: are all set on a scenic valley slope with views over rice and tea terraces and multiple water features

facts.text: The resort is divided into two zones, one representing the cultural heritage of the north and the other the contemporary Veranda style.
facts.excerpt: Divided into two zones, on one side representing the cultural heritage of the north and the other the Contemporary Veranda style.

facts.text: The infinity pool is on the roof terrace of the main building, overlooking the valley.
facts.excerpt: Veranda high infinity pool is on the roof terrace of the main building over looking the valley

facts.text: Each spa cottage is a self-contained private spa with a large sunken bath, steam shower and twin treatment beds suited to couples.
facts.excerpt: Each private cottage is a self contained spa with large sunken bath, Steam shower and twin treatment beds ideal for couples

facts.text: Spa treatment products have been developed by the resort's own experienced therapist.
facts.excerpt: All products used for treatments have been developed by our own experienced therapist

facts.text: Room types with private pools include the Plunge Pool Pavilion, Pool Villa and Presidential Pool Villa.
facts.excerpt: offers several room types with private pools, including the Plunge Pool Pavilion (with a private plunge pool), Pool Villa, and Presidential Pool Villa

facts.text: All rooms feature contemporary Lanna design, a private balcony with mountain or garden views, and a bathtub.
facts.excerpt: All rooms feature contemporary Lanna design, a private balcony with mountain or garden views, a bathtub, and a Smart TV.

facts.text: The Luxury Pool Villa has three bedrooms, a private pool, a fully equipped kitchen and a poolside dining area with panoramic valley views.
facts.excerpt: Three bedrooms give every generation room to spread out, while the private pool, fully equipped kitchen and poolside dining area make it easy to swim

facts.text: The Presidential Pool Villa includes a private pool, private garden, a terrace with panoramic valley views and dedicated Villa Host service.
facts.excerpt: a private swimming pool, private garden, multiple bedrooms, a living room, a bathroom with bathtub, a terrace with panoramic valley views, and dedicated Villa Host service

facts.text: Rabiang Cha is a modern version of a traditional northern rice granary, with views of rice and tea terraces and a menu fusing Lanna Thai cuisine with a modern touch.
facts.excerpt: The restaurant is modern version of a traditional northern rice granary each private room has air conditioned comfort.

facts.text: The Higher Room is an all-day dining restaurant with outdoor al fresco seating looking over the infinity-edged pool and the valley.
facts.excerpt: outdoor al fresco with views over the infinity edged pool and the valley beyond

facts.text: The Cultural Pavilion offers Thai cooking, yoga and Muay Thai.
facts.excerpt: Learn the art of thai cooking, Yoga and Muay Thai.

facts.text: Guests can join a hands-on rice planting experience in the rice field.
facts.excerpt: Step into the rice field and discover how one of Thailand’s most important crops is grown through a hands-on farming experience.

facts.text: Morning alms giving introduces guests to Thai Buddhist tradition.
facts.excerpt: Introduce the family to Thai Buddhist tradition through the peaceful experience of morning alms giving.

facts.text: The Kids' Club offers educational toys and a daily programme of indoor and outdoor activities.
facts.excerpt: Educational toys and a daily programme of indoor and outdoor activities give younger guests somewhere to play and explore.

facts.text: A separate children's pool sits alongside the mountain-view infinity pool.
facts.excerpt: Alongside the resort’s mountain-view infinity pool is a separate children’s pool

facts.text: A tunnel of polished concrete cooled by falling water forms the entrance into the resort's inner courtyard.
facts.excerpt: A tunnel of polished concrete cooled by falling water creates a dramatic entrance into the resort’s inner courtyard

facts.text: The resort is a compound of timber and concrete structures scattered across a valley of rice paddies, wildflowers and tropical greenery.
facts.excerpt: This breathtaking compound of timber and concrete structures scattered across a valley dense with rice paddies, wildflowers, and tropical greenery

facts.text: Sunrise yoga overlooking the valley is offered on scheduled mornings.
facts.excerpt: Wake with the mountains and begin the day slowly with yoga overlooking the valley.

facts.text: Within the resort grounds there are scenic walking trails and valley-view photo spots.
facts.excerpt: Within the resort grounds there are scenic walking trails and valley-view photo spots

facts.text: Doi Suthep Temple is about 50 minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Doi Suthep Temple (50 min)

facts.text: The resort can arrange private dinners or cocktail parties in a variety of locations throughout the resort.
facts.excerpt: private dinner or cocktail parties can be arranged in a variety of locations throughout the resort to celebrate birthdays, anniversaries or a memorable moment
